title: XCP Configuration
description: Measure one or more ECUs over XCP, with signals named and scaled by each ECU's A2L file.

ecus.title: ECUs
ecus.description: Add an ECU for each XCP slave to measure, or use Auto-configure for a demo ECU.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: How the extension reaches the ECU. XCP on CAN: SocketCAN (Zelos) (Linux, zelos-can's SocketCAN bus), SocketCAN over SSH (Zelos) (a remote Linux device's SocketCAN over SSH, from any OS), SocketCAN (python-can), PCAN, Kvaser, Vector, slcan, or Other (any python-can interface). XCP on UDP or TCP, as the ECU provides. Demo: a built-in simulated ECU with no hardware. A wrong choice looks the same as no ECU. The extension connects when it starts, and an ECU serves one XCP tool at a time: connecting can end another tool's session (CANape, INCA) without an error on either side.

name.title: Name
name.description: Label this ECU appears under in the trace. Letters, digits, space, '_' and '-' only. Defaults to the host address or CAN channel, sanitized, or 'demo'.

a2l_file.title: A2L File
a2l_file.description: The ECU's A2L database, from the same firmware build as the ECU. It gives every measurement its address, type, conversion and unit. A path on the agent's host: absolute or starting with ~

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.description: What to measure. Each group becomes one trace event per ECU event. Name the signals here, in a list file, or both.

event.title: Event
event.description: 'default' samples each signal on the event its A2L entry names, and polls at Rate the signals that name none. Or name one ECU event channel from the A2L (e.g. 10ms) for the whole group, or 'poll' to read the signals on a fixed rate instead.

rate_ms.title: Rate (ms)
rate_ms.description: Poll rate: of the group when Event is 'poll', of signals with no A2L event when it is 'default'.

signals.title: Signals
signals.description: A2L measurement names, exactly as the A2L writes them (e.g. motor.ctrl.id_ref).

signals_file.title: Signal List File
signals_file.description: A text file of A2L measurement names, one per line, added to Signals. A label file (.lab) from INCA or CANape works: its rates are ignored. A path on the agent's host: absolute or starting with ~

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: SocketCAN interface name (can0, vcan0, slcan0, ...). Choose from the interfaces on the machine running the agent, or type a name.

fd_mode.title: CAN-FD Mode
fd_mode.description: Enable CAN-FD for higher data rates and larger payloads

config_json.title: Advanced Configuration (JSON)
config_json.description: Additional python-can Bus() kwargs as JSON object

tx_id.title: Command CAN ID
tx_id.description: CAN id the extension sends XCP commands on (master to ECU), hex, e.g. 0x7F0. Leave empty to take CAN_ID_MASTER from the A2L.

rx_id.title: Response CAN ID
rx_id.description: CAN id the ECU answers and sends DAQ data on (ECU to master), hex, e.g. 0x7F1. Leave empty to take CAN_ID_SLAVE from the A2L.

extended_ids.title: Extended IDs
extended_ids.description: The two CAN ids above are 29-bit extended ids. Ids taken from the A2L carry their own format.

remote_host.title: Remote Host
remote_host.description: Hostname or IP of the edge device running SocketCAN, reached over SSH (may be a ~/.ssh/config alias)

remote_channel.title: Remote CAN Channel
remote_channel.description: SocketCAN interface name on the remote edge device (e.g. can0, vcan0)

ssh_user.title: SSH User
ssh_user.description: Username for the SSH connection (optional; falls back to your ssh config / current user)

ssh_port.title: SSH Port
ssh_port.description: TCP port for the SSH connection

ssh_key_path.title: SSH Key File
ssh_key_path.description: Path to a private key file for SSH authentication (optional)

ssh_host_key_policy.title: SSH Host Key Policy
ssh_host_key_policy.description: How to treat the edge's SSH host key. 'auto' trusts whatever key the device presents and records nothing, so a reimaged device (which comes back with a new key) reconnects with no manual step. 'strict' uses your own ~/.ssh/known_hosts: an unknown or changed key is reported and the bus stops, rather than retrying.

ssh_extra_opts.title: SSH Extra Options
ssh_extra_opts.description: Additional ssh command-line options, space-separated (e.g. -J bastion). Placed before the options above; ssh honours the first -o it sees, so these win over the settings above.

ssh_hw_timestamps.title: Hardware timestamps
ssh_hw_timestamps.description: Uses the adapter's hardware clock when the edge's candump supports -H; interfaces without one (vcan, some slcan) fall back to the extension's wall clock. Turn off to use the edge kernel's receive time.

tx_id.description: CAN id the extension sends XCP commands on (master to ECU), hex, e.g. 0x7F0. Leave empty to take CAN_ID_MASTER from the A2L.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the ECU

demo_transport.title: Demo Transport
demo_transport.description: How the built-in simulated ECU is reached: XCP on CAN over an in-memory virtual bus, or XCP on UDP or TCP on loopback.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Settings that apply to every ECU.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Leading trace source every ECU publishes under, so events read '<prefix>/<ecu>/<event>'. Clear it to give each ECU its own trace source with events '<event>'.

timestamp_mode.title: Timestamp Mode
timestamp_mode.description: Which clock places samples in the trace: 'auto' uses the ECU's timestamp when it sends one, anchored to local time once at measurement start, otherwise the local receive time; 'host' always uses the local receive time.

epk_check.title: EPK Check
epk_check.description: Compare the A2L's EPK (firmware build id) with the ECU's at connect. 'strict' refuses to measure on a mismatch, since a stale A2L reads plausible but wrong values; 'warn' logs the mismatch and measures anyway.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for the ECU to answer a command before retrying

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: Extra attempts per command before it counts as failed. Each failed command costs timeout x (1 + retries).

max_bus_load.title: Max Bus Load (%)
max_bus_load.description: XCP on CAN: measurement is refused when the DAQ traffic of the selection is estimated above this share of the bus bitrate; leave empty for no limit. The estimate counts the XCP frames only, not the bus's other traffic, and is always reported.

debug_frames.title: Debug Frames
debug_frames.description: Log every XCP command, response and event packet (direction, PID, bytes) at DEBUG level, and DAQ packets per second, never their data. Set Log Level to DEBUG to see them.
